kind: Offline actual Three.js road-hazard visual checks
limitations: No browser, WebGL shader compilation, GPU performance or Android validation.

checks.name: 68 hazards use six bounded instanced pools and two merged patch meshes
yellow repair faces have code-native black stripes and outward-facing normals
solid horizontal bounds match their exact OBBs and sit into the curved road
sand and ice use their full local soft-physics footprint with ground-conforming vertices
warning rock and footprint appear before the drop at 170m with no hidden collider
repeated runs reuse every mesh, material, geometry and typed instance buffer
multiple seeded curved/hilly layouts keep patch edges and solid footprints aligned
dispose is idempotent and releases the shared checker only after its last owner
